unarmed-20.title: 20 HR UNARMED SECURITY COURSE
unarmed-20.location: 100% Online LMS Portal (Phone, Tablet, or PC — platformstraining.com)
unarmed-20.rangeNote: 100% Online • Self-Paced 24/7 • Receive Official Form IL486-0486 Certificate Immediately Upon Completion (No Wait).
unarmed-20.description: Official IDFPR-approved 20-hour curriculum required for all unarmed security officers in Illinois to obtain a Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC). Complete all 10 modules and the exam online 24/7 and download your official certificate immediately.
prerequisites: Must be at least 18 years of age
Eligible to obtain an Illinois PERC Card (IDFPR)
No disqualifying felony convictions
curriculum: Illinois Private Detective, Private Alarm, Private Security Act of 2004 (225 ILCS 447)
Role of the Security Officer, ethics, professional conduct & de-escalation
Illinois Criminal Code & Arrest Powers (720 ILCS 5/7-1 vs. 5/7-3)
Force Continuum, use of non-deadly force, liability & citizen's arrest laws
Report writing, incident documentation, evidence preservation & patrol procedures
Emergency response, fire safety, terrorism awareness & active threat protocols
unarmed-20.cancellation: Instant 24/7 online access upon registration. Immediate certificate issuance upon passing.

armed-28.title: 28 HR ONLINE ARMED SECURITY COURSE
armed-28.duration: 20 Hrs Self-Paced Online (24/7) + 8-Hr Live-Fire Range Qualification
armed-28.location: Online LMS (20-Hr Classroom) + Range Qualification: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
armed-28.rangeNote: All-inclusive $200 tuition covers 20 hours online + 8-hour live-fire qualification (ammo, targets & range fees included). Already paid online? Select a range date below at $0 extra cost.
armed-28.description: Authorized under 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1240.510 (IDFPR Approved Curriculum #102-000398). Select your in-person range qualification date, complete all 10 armed classroom modules (20 hours) and the untimed 50-question written exam 100% online 24/7, and save your Form IL486-1138 record to your profile for Instructor Charles Young to sign off after range qualification and email to you and FPR.SafetyUnit@illinois.gov.
prerequisites: Prerequisite: 20-Hour Unarmed Security Course Certificate
Complete 20-Hour Online Armed Classroom & Written Exam prior to Range Day
Must be at least 21 years of age with valid FOID Card
No felony convictions or disqualifying battery convictions
Duty belt and suitable range attire
curriculum: IDFPR Approved Curriculum #102-000398 (20 Hours Online): Illinois 225 ILCS 447, FCC rules, FOID & 720 ILCS 5/7 Use of Deadly Force
20 Hours Online: Semi-auto pistol & DA/SA revolver mechanics, malfunctions & 5 marksmanship fundamentals
8 Hours In-Person Range: Safety briefing, 4-count holster draw & dry-fire coaching at Eagle Sports Range
8 Hours In-Person Range: Official IDFPR 50-round live-fire qualification (5, 7 & 10 yards, min 35/50 = 70%)
Instructor Charles Young completes IDFPR Form IL486-1138 in the Admin Portal and sends copies to the student and FPR.SafetyUnit@illinois.gov
armed-28.cancellation: Online portal unlocks 24/7 immediately upon $200 enrollment. Range qualification dates may be scheduled or rescheduled within 3 months at no extra cost.

firearm-requal.title: SECURITY FIREARM REQUALIFICATION
firearm-requal.location: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
firearm-requal.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
firearm-requal.description: Annual qualification course required by the IDFPR to maintain an active Firearms Control Card (Tan Card) for employed armed security officers in Illinois.
prerequisites: Current or previously issued Firearms Control Card (Tan Card) holder
Valid FOID Card
Approved duty firearm and retention holster
curriculum: Review of safety procedures, holster inspection, and state guidelines
State-mandated qualification course of fire
Official instructor sign-off paperwork for employer and IDFPR records

firearm-upgrade.title: SECURITY FIREARM UPGRADE QUAL
firearm-upgrade.location: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
firearm-upgrade.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
firearm-upgrade.description: Allows armed security personnel to add revolver or semi-automatic handgun endorsements to their existing IDFPR Firearms Control Card (Tan Card).
prerequisites: Active or pending Armed Security Officer certification
Firearm to be endorsed and suitable retention holster
curriculum: Proficiency and manual of arms on additional weapon platform
Holster drawing and tactical reloading drills
Live-fire qualification test on new weapon platform

ccl-16.title: 16 HR IL CONCEALED CARRY COURSE
ccl-16.location: Classroom: 200 E 75th St, Chicago, IL 60619 | Range: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
ccl-16.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
ccl-16.description: Complete training satisfying the full state requirement for the Illinois Concealed Carry License (CCL). Covers safe weapon handling, holster draw, marksmanship, Illinois statutes, and live-fire range qualification.
prerequisites: Must be at least 21 years old
Valid FOID Card or eligible for FOID
Suitable belt for range day holster work
curriculum: Firearm safety rules and fundamentals of defensive pistol shooting
Holster retention, concealed draw stroke, and malfunction clearing
Illinois Concealed Carry Act (430 ILCS 66) & prohibited carry locations
Federal firearms laws and interstate travel regulations
Official 30-round ISP live-fire qualification at 5, 7, and 10 yards
ccl-16.cancellation: No refunds. Classes can be rescheduled within 3 months.

ccl-8.title: 8 HR IL CONCEALED CARRY COURSE
ccl-8.location: Classroom: 200 E 75th St, Chicago, IL 60619 | Range: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
ccl-8.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
ccl-8.description: For individuals who have completed recognized 8-hour prior courses (such as NRA Basic Pistol or Personal Protection in the Home). Covers Illinois law and statutory qualification requirements.
prerequisites: Official Certificate from recognized 8-hour prior course
Must be at least 21 years old
Valid FOID Card or eligibility
curriculum: Illinois Concealed Carry Act comprehensive legal review
Justifiable use of deadly force under Illinois law (720 ILCS 5/7-1)
Live-fire 30-round ISP qualification test at Eagle Sports Range

ccl-military.title: 8 HR IL CCL – MILITARY & LEO
ccl-military.location: Classroom: 200 E 75th St, Chicago, IL 60619 | Range: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
ccl-military.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
ccl-military.description: Honoring our service members and first responders with special tuition. Military DD-214 or law enforcement verification qualifies you for 8 hours of prior credit, requiring only this 8-hour Illinois law and range qualification course.
prerequisites: Valid Military ID, DD-214 (Honorable Discharge), or Law Enforcement ID
Must be 21+ years old
curriculum: Illinois statutory law and lawful use of force updates
Public interactions and law enforcement contact guidelines for armed citizens
Official ISP live-fire range qualification test

ccl-refresher.title: 3 HR IL CCL REFRESHER COURSE
ccl-refresher.location: Eagle Sports Range (5900 W 159th St, Oak Forest, IL 60452)
ccl-refresher.rangeNote: Ammo, targets, and range fees are included. Bring eye & ear protection (also available at range).
ccl-refresher.description: State-mandated 3-hour renewal course required every 5 years to keep your Illinois Concealed Carry License in good standing. Includes legal updates and required live-fire qualification.
prerequisites: Current or expiring Illinois Concealed Carry License
Approved firearm and belt holster
curriculum: Review of Illinois Concealed Carry Act changes and recent case law updates
Mental conditioning, situational awareness, and defensive decision-making
Official 30-round live-fire qualification
